symptom: Task fails ResourceInitializationError 'failed to mount EFS volume: ... transit encryption mismatch'. Task-def says transitEncryption=ENABLED but EFS mount-target SG doesn't allow port 2049 from task SG, OR EFS access point requires IAM and task lacks perms.

diagnostic_steps.command: aws efs describe-mount-targets --file-system-id <fs>; aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids <mt-sg>

diagnostic_steps.action: If iam=ENABLED on volume, check executionRoleArn has elasticfilesystem:ClientMount + ClientWrite

fix_steps.action: Open port 2049 in EFS mount target SG from task SG
fix_steps.command: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id <mt-sg> --protocol tcp --port 2049 --source-group <task-sg>

fix_steps.action: Add ClientMount/ClientWrite to executionRole if iam=ENABLED
fix_steps.command: Attach policy with elasticfilesystem:ClientMount + ClientWrite scoped to the file-system ARN

symptom: Task fails ResourceInitializationError 'failed to create container: failed to initialize logging driver: awslogs: log group does not exist'. awslogs-create-group not set + group doesn't exist.

fix_steps.action: Pre-create the log group (recommended)
fix_steps.command: aws logs create-log-group --log-group-name <group>; aws logs put-retention-policy --log-group-name <group> --retention-in-days 30

fix_steps.action: Or set awslogs-create-group=true in log options + grant logs:CreateLogGroup to executionRole
fix_steps.command: Update task def options.awslogs-create-group=true; add IAM perm

symptom: FireLens log-router container exits immediately. Task stops with 'essential container exited' for the firelens container; app logs lost. Fluent Bit parsed config-file-value with syntax error.

diagnostic_steps.action: Read firelens container logs from prior failed task

fix_steps.action: Fix the config file; bump revision (S3 or built-in)
fix_steps.command: Validate locally; push to S3 (if config-file-type=s3); register new task-def revision

symptom: Fargate task fills its scratch disk; container crashes with 'no space left on device'. Default ephemeralStorage is 20 GiB; bigger images / scratch usage exceeds.

fix_steps.action: Raise ephemeralStorage (Fargate platform 1.4.0+, range 21-200)
fix_steps.command: Update task-def: ephemeralStorage.sizeInGiB=50; register new revision

fix_steps.action: For larger needs, attach EBS volume (configuredAtLaunch, Fargate platform 1.4+)
fix_steps.command: Add task-def volume with configuredAtLaunch=true; provide volume config at run-task time

symptom: CodeDeploy blue/green ECS deployment fails to roll back. Old (blue) target group still receiving 0 traffic; service stuck. Manual ALB intervention needed.

fix_steps.action: Stop the failed deployment + manually swap ALB listener back to blue TG
fix_steps.command: aws deploy stop-deployment --deployment-id <id> --auto-rollback-enabled; aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn <l> --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=<blue-tg>

fix_steps.action: Diagnose + retry once root cause fixed
fix_steps.command: Fix the lifecycle hook script / IAM perm; new CodeDeploy deployment

symptom: Task in account A pulls from ECR in account B; CannotPullContainerError. Cross-account ECR repo policy doesn't allow account A's executionRole.

diagnostic_steps.expected: Statement allowing account A's executionRole arn principal

fix_steps.action: Add cross-account permission to ECR repo policy
fix_steps.command: aws ecr set-repository-policy --registry-id <accountB> --repository-name <repo> --policy-text '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"CrossAcct","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::<accountA>:role/<execRole>"},"Action":["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage","ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"]}]}'

symptom: External instance fails to register. ecs-init log: 'ssm activation expired or invalid'. SSM activation token has 30-day max TTL.

fix_steps.action: Create new activation + re-run ecs-anywhere-install.sh on the instance
fix_steps.command: aws ssm create-activation --iam-role <role> --registration-limit 100 --expiration-date $(date -d '+30 days' --iso-8601=seconds); on instance: curl ... | bash -s -- --activation-id <new> --activation-code <new>

symptom: aws ecs execute-command fails: 'The execute command failed because execute command was not enabled when the Task was run'.

diagnostic_steps.action: Check task IAM role has SSM perms
diagnostic_steps.command: aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn <taskRole> --action-names ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel

fix_steps.action: Update service to enable Exec + grant taskRole SSM perms
fix_steps.command: aws ecs update-service --cluster <c> --service <s> --enable-execute-command; force new deployment; attach AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore (or specific 4 ssmmessages perms) to taskRole

symptom: Task fails to start: 'volume name X already exists'. Two task-def volumes with the same name; OR mountPoint references a volume name that doesn't exist in volumes[].

diagnostic_steps.expected: Volume names unique; every mountPoint.sourceVolume matches a volume name

fix_steps.action: Rename duplicates / fix mountPoint.sourceVolume references
fix_steps.command: Update task-def JSON; register new revision

symptom: Task transitions to STOPPING but never reaches STOPPED. Held there for many minutes. Container won't respond to SIGTERM.

diagnostic_steps.action: SSH to instance + force-kill if EC2 launch type

fix_steps.action: App should handle SIGTERM cleanly within stopTimeout
fix_steps.command: Add SIGTERM handler that flushes + exits

fix_steps.action: Set linuxParameters.initProcessEnabled=true to use tini PID 1 (forwards signals correctly)
fix_steps.command: Add to task-def container.linuxParameters

symptom: API calls return 'enable the new ARN format with account-setting before using this feature'. Tagging-aware features need new ARN format.

fix_steps.action: Enable for the calling principal
fix_steps.command: aws ecs put-account-setting --name taskLongArnFormat --value enabled; same for containerInstanceLongArnFormat + serviceLongArnFormat

symptom: Task fails ResourceInitializationError 'environment file s3://bucket/file not accessible'. Bucket/key missing or executionRole lacks s3:GetObject.

diagnostic_steps.action: Check executionRole has s3:GetObject + bucket policy allows

fix_steps.action: Add S3 read perms to executionRole + bucket policy
fix_steps.command: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name <execRole> --policy-name read-envs --policy-document '{...s3:GetObject on bucket+key...}'

symptom: Fargate service pinned to platformVersion=1.3.0 hits behavior bugs that 1.4+ fixes. Or pin to LATEST and behavior changes broke an integration.

fix_steps.action: Set platformVersion=1.4.0 (or latest stable) for new features
fix_steps.command: aws ecs update-service --cluster <c> --service <s> --platform-version 1.4.0; force-new-deployment

fix_steps.action: If chasing LATEST broke things, pin a known-good version
fix_steps.command: Set platform-version=1.4.0 explicitly

symptom: Fargate task fails to launch: 'unsupported parameter: privileged' or 'sysctl X not allowed'. Fargate restricts privileged + many sysctls + capabilities.

diagnostic_steps.expected: None of the Fargate-forbidden features set

fix_steps.action: Remove the restricted parameter OR migrate to EC2 launch type
fix_steps.command: Update task-def to drop privileged/restricted sysctl/capability; OR change launchType=EC2

symptom: Bare-metal EC2 instance hosting Firecracker-based workloads exhibits performance degradation. Investigation shows Firecracker not configured per fc-docs-prod-host-setup recommendations on the host.

diagnostic_steps.action: Verify host kernel cmdline includes 'quiet loglevel=1 nosmt'

fix_steps.action: Apply Firecracker production-host hardening to the bare-metal instance
fix_steps.command: Cross-reference firecracker.setup.production-checklist concept + per-fix steps in firecracker.setup.fm.* failure_modes
fix_steps.validation: Host meets the Firecracker production checklist
